selection: Descending 2022 median daily sum of typical candle price times volume, among complete eligible regular sessions. Numeric security ID breaks ties. Current survivor/download coverage limitation.
decision_semantics: Completed minute identified by start bucket t. Features available at t+1 minute boundary. Entry reference open at t+2 minutes, a full minute later; exit open at entry+h minutes.
session_admission: Exactly 375 unique minute buckets09:15..15:29IST, finite consistent positive OHLC/nonnegative volume/positive session total; timestamp seconds floored and weekend excluded. Ex-post full-day admission creates coverage selection bias.
relative_volume: Each same-minute volume divided by mean of up to20strictly prior eligible sessions, minimum5. No current or future session in baseline.
context: Equal-weight leave-one-out synchronized stock peers, minimum4, using only current completed-minute returns. This is a peer proxy, not an index/sector or tradable hedge.
limitations: No bid/ask, original trade events, quote age or size capacity in historical candles
Corporate actions and original candle timestamp labeling unverified
Current survivor universe and ex-post full-session availability bias
Current frozen NSE tariff on earlier years is a counterfactual sensitivity
No untouched final-holdout claim for previously available history
